newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens links with India's BHEL.
newsitem.headline: Siemens links with India's BHEL.

text.p: Germany's Siemens AG said on Thursday it had formed a joint venture engineering company with India's Bharat Heavy Electricals Ltd to carry out upgrades on thermal power plants.
The two partners will have equal shares in the venture, which will improve output and efficiency at old power stations as well as cutting their emission of pollution.

Siemens said in a statement that the joint venture between the two companies, which have cooperated since 1974, would help to overcome bottlenecks in power supply in India. The venture would also be active in other countries.
BHEL has annual sales of around 2.2 billion marks ($1.4 billion) , and is also active in power transmission, transportation, industrial building systems, oil and gas industry and telecommunications.
Siemens' power generation group has annual sales of around eight billion marks. Around half of the thermal power stations operating in India are based on Siemens technology.
-- Douglas Busvine, Bonn newsroom, 49-228-26097150 ($ = 1.527 German Marks)
